Name: Milkable Sasquatch
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Ever wish you could have the Sasquatch as a barn animal?

....

No? Are you sure?

...

Well anyways, now you can!

Introducing the Sasquatch, an animal that can be hatched from the Sasquatch egg, found during a rare night event.

Put the ﻿Sasquatch egg into an ostrich incubator in order to have your very own﻿ Sasquatch!
The Sasquatch produces eggs, milk, fur, and feet! Yes, you heard that right! Your ﻿Sasquatch can be milked!

... Why?

....

Don't worry about it!

Sasquatch produce can be processed into mayonnaise and cheese for all you foodies out there! The fur can even be tailored into a cute ﻿Sasquatch mask!

The mod config can be used to give the ostrich incubator recipe after you get the Sasquatch egg and to remove the cinder shards from the recipe for easier access. By default these options are turned off. If using another mod that changes the ostrich egg incubator recipe leave the config off.

-Note: When it's not ready to be sheared/milked it will say that the Sasquatch doesn't produce wool/milk instead of the regular not ready message, but if you wait you'll be able to shear/milk.

Manifest.Name: Sasquatch Barn Animal
Manifest.Description: Adds a Sasquatch to the barn.
